text:
OpsBot: ALERT: unusual spike in PagerDuty delivery latency detected for routing key prod-critical at 10:12 UTC — delivery latency > 60s for 23 events. Auto-threading into #incidents.

Samir: seeing it too, a handful of pages didn't arrive for me. trying to reproduce.

Tara (oncall): I missed a page 10:14 -> woke up to voicemail. confirm whether ack failed or delivery never happened.

Lee H: checking event ingestion logs now — looks like our event webhook to PagerDuty returned 202s but delivery timestamps from PD show queued/delayed.

Raj P: PagerDuty status page shows a "Events delivery delay" notice: https://status.pagerduty.com/incidents/abc123 (link).

Samir: copy. run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Token token=$PD_TOKEN" "https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents?since=2024-06-10T10:00:00Z" | jq '.incidents[] | {id,status,created_at}'` — PD shows created_at earlier but notification_sent_at is later in many.

Tara (oncall): customer-impact? are pages for user-facing page fails or internal-only alerts?

Lee H: these are mostly infra alerts (upstreams, node OOM). A few customer-facing support pages (support-oncall) may have been delayed. Support flagged 3 users who reported delayed responses.

Samir: immediate mitigation: enabling fallback Slack webhooks for the critical routing key. I've pushed a rule in our alertmanager to fanout to slack and sms for prod-critical.

Raj P: adding manual phone tree: paging Samir -> Tara -> Lee until PD resolves. Samir, can you take primary?

Samir: taking primary. I will manually call the next 3 on the list for any new prod-critical alerts.

PagerDuty Support Bot: Ticket #PD-98271 created with PD support. PD acknowledgment: "We're investigating increased event delivery latency across multiple regions." ETA unknown.

Tara (oncall): updating incident playbook note: mark "PagerDuty notification delays" and switch to manual paging for all P0/P1 for now.

Lee H: digging into our routing rules — nothing changed on our side, signatures/keys valid, no 5xx from PD. Looks like internal PD queueing. Also seeing some ack state mismatches: events show as acknowledged on our side but PD shows unacknowledged for ~10m.

Samir: could be PD routing table changes causing delayed ack propagation. PD status page says "acknowledgement processing delay" — matches.

Tara (oncall): customer comms: support team, please post an internal note to CS that some support responses may be delayed by ~10-30m. No data loss reported.

Raj P: telemetry: pushing a quick dashboard showing event -> pd-delivery -> notif_sent times for the last 2 hours so we can quantify percent impacted.

Samir: quantified: ~4% of prod-critical events had >60s notification latency, ~0.6% had >5m, 3 support tickets reported delayed response (customers A, B, C). No SLA breaches yet but close.

PagerDuty Support Bot: PD update: "Root cause identified: internal event ingestion queue throttling due to a partial service outage in region us-east-1. Working on a mitigation; retries in flight."

Lee H: okay, mitigation actions while PD fixes: 1) keep Slack webhook fanout for critical routes, 2) enable short-circuit SMS provider (Twilio) for P0, 3) increase alert aggregation window to 45s to reduce duplicate noisy pages. Who can toggle Twilio?

Samir: I can. I'll enable Twilio SMS for the next 60 minutes for prod-critical.

Tara (oncall): I'll take on-call handoff at 11:00 UTC. Samir, please brief me on state then.

Samir: noted. current checklist in thread:
- PD ticket #PD-98271 (open)
- Slack webhook fanout enabled (done)
- Twilio SMS fallback enabled (done)
- Manual phone tree active (Samir primary)
- Telemetry dashboard live: https://dash.internal/reports/pd_delivery_latency
- Customer impact: 3 delayed support responses, no data loss

Raj P: PD just posted another update: "Mitigation deployed, delivery latencies returning to normal. We will monitor for 2 hours."

Tara (oncall): Samir — I'll ack handoff at 11:00 and monitor PD updates. If PD doesn't confirm full resolution in 30m, we'll keep Twilio on and escalate to PD engineering contact.

Samir: great. one follow-up action: after this is fully cleared, we should add a playbook item for "PD delivery delays" and implement a health-check that alerts when PD notification latency > 30s so we can failover earlier.

Lee H: agree. also add an automated failover that converts prod-critical to dual-route (PD + Slack/SMS) when PD latency > 20s for N events.

PagerDuty Support Bot: PD update (final): "Service fully restored. All queues processed. No events lost. Follow-up report will be posted."

Tara (oncall): closing live mitigation. Samir — please create a post-incident ticket with timeline, impacted customers, and retention of the PD ticket. We'll decide whether to file a vendor escalation for SLA credit.

Samir: creating postmortem ticket now: PM-1248. Adding timeline and actions.

Raj P: thumbs. we should also run a DR drill in Q3 to exercise manual paging.

OpsBot: NOTE: Incident thread archived to /incidents/pagerduty-delivery-2024-06 for postmortem.

Samir: thanks everyone. moving to follow-ups.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from Tara (oncall), :eyes: from Lee H)
